title: 2012 Delhi gang rape and murder
narrative: FIR — 16 December 2012, a private bus in Munirka, Delhi. Jyoti Singh, a 22-year-old physiotherapy intern, was gang-raped, tortured with an iron rod and murdered; her companion Awindra Pratap Pandey was assaulted and survived. The accused were Ram Singh (the bus driver, who died in custody), Mukesh Singh, Vinay Sharma, Akshay Thakur, Pawan Gupta and a juvenile. An iron rod was used. The Delhi Police Special Investigation Team was led by Pramod Kumar Kushwaha. Evidence included DNA, fingerprints, dental bite-mark modelling and two blood-stained metal rods. The four adult convicts were sentenced to death and executed on 20 March 2020.
